panels.title: Скоры и доля фрода по версии модели

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(model_version,'unknown') AS model_version, count(*) AS scores, avg(fraud_flag::float)*100 AS fraud_percent FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY scores DESC

WITH bins AS (SELECT least(19,floor(score*20)::int) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(bucket*0.05,'FM0.00') || '–' || to_char((bucket+1)*0.05,'FM0.00') AS score_interval, n::float / (sum(n) OVER () * 0.05) AS density FROM bins ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: TPS выбранного сегмента по времени записи

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '$__interval'), count(*) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS tps FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Доля фрода по категории — последние 1000 строк (глобально)

targets.rawSql: WITH recent AS (SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag FROM scores ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT coalesce(cat_id,'unknown') AS category, avg(fraud_flag::float)*100 AS fraud_percent FROM recent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY fraud_percent DESC

panels.title: Объём средств, помеченных как фрод — выбранный сегмент

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '$__interval'), coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud_flag=1),0) AS flagged_amount FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
